description: Learner variant: se1_lgbm_mm (champion's features, se1's tree params, rows and window) refitted on every frame row after the inner fit, with the inner best iteration and temperature (DESIGN_V1 section 32). Registered because the section 32 development probe q0516 (walk forward 2026-10-19..10-23, 200k rows, event-clustered) met the rule fixed before it ran: gain over se1 on all three direction targets, each CI above zero, 5/5 days positive (dir_2h +0.0016, dir_6h +0.0027, dir_24h +0.0017 nats). That gain is development evidence, small and possibly optimistic; prospective scoring decides. Not embargoed (no family).
